families.shared_gamma: P=3+3L. One gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell controls per layer. L=6 has 21 parameters.
families.qaoa: P=2p. p=10 has 20, p=11 has 22, p=12 has 24. No integer p has 21.
families.layer_gamma: Different family. A gamma per layer, shared thetaK and thetaM, three shells per layer. P=4L+2. L=5 has 22, equal to p=11. L=6 has 26.
families.layer_theta: Different family. One gamma, thetaK and thetaM per layer, three shells per layer. P=5L+1. L=4 has 21. L=6 has 31.
families.drop_K: Different family. thetaK fixed at 0. P=2+3L. L=6 has 20, equal to p=10.
families.drop_M: Different family. thetaM fixed at 0. P=2+3L. L=6 has 20.
families.contiguous: Different packing, same shared-gamma generator. Sites [[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8]]. L=6 has 21.

p11_reference: lowest energy p=11 row in N9_r1/results/records.jsonl

pilot.init: normal(0, 0.35) at L=1, then layer-center continuation

replace_six_start_only_if: the held-out family beats equal-depth p=6 and matched p=11 on both metrics for the majority of its chains
